significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish that a low-dimensional residual-stream object whose projection marks answer stability causally controls reasoning duration: “adding the direction as a steering vector induces earlier commitment; ablating it prolongs deliberation.” This is primarily form (ii)—a separable direction, causal role, and intervention for one behavior—rather than a transferable law, although the claimed prediction of the “earliest safe exit point” adds a limited measurable coupling; it establishes both the early-commitment phenomenon and a concrete mechanism, fixing expectations about stabilization and intervention effects. The negative branch would usefully rule out commitment as a single linear causal variable, but would not rule out nonlinear or distributed commitment, confidence signals, or early exit generally; true and false therefore denote distinguishable but bounded conclusions. Relative to the obvious topic-level hypothesis that an internal confidence or answer-stability signal can support adaptive computation—as represented behaviorally by CALM (Schuster et al., ICLR 2023)—the causal bidirectionality is somewhat sharper, but the topic-substitution check shows the topic alone would not justify an above-median score.

reach.justification: The named handle is an “early-exit controller that monitors the commit-vector projection and halts CoT when it crosses a calibrated threshold,” an ex-ante diagnostic and intervention that fires before redundant reasoning tokens are generated and therefore leaves an actionable compute-saving window. Its immediate downstream users could include inference-system practitioners who gate or ship reasoning models, not merely interpretability researchers, and adaptive-computation systems such as CALM demonstrate that confidence-conditioned early stopping is operationally relevant. After re-extraction on another model, the claim predicts a coupling between projection, answer stability, and safe stopping, but it does not state a quantitative invariant or guarantee that the same direction or threshold transfers; indeed, whether the direction is shared is only posed as a question, so the substantive handle may require rediscovery across models. The asserted scope covers math, logic, and code reasoning, while cross-model universality remains unstated; after topic substitution, the particular ex-ante commit-vector controller—not efficient reasoning in general—still supports reach above the topic median.
